messages.subject: Revised schedule of loss - please confirm the recall numbers
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Attached is the revised schedule of loss. Could you confirm the recall figure - we've used 286 units returned and a rework/recall head of £648,900, and the Stratton liability at £425,000 (£275k liquidated damages + £150k rebate). Total comes to £1,558,150.

If those tie to your ledger we'll lock the schedule and serve it with the amended Particulars.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
